test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

My teacher told me that / all that / glitters was not gold.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the third part of the given sentence, the** singular form of the verb** 'was' is incorrect.
 
• The correct proverb is **"All that glitters is not gold."**
 
• The correct form of the verb 'is' should be used in place of the singular form 'was'.

Hence, the correct statement is **'*My teacher told me that all that glitters is not gold.'__***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other parts of the sentence are correct having no grammatical error.
